workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the overlapping free 30-min slots for both of them:

- Mon 09:00-10:00 (60 min available)
- Tue 13:00-14:00 (60 min available)
- Tue 16:30-17:00 (30 min available)
- Wed 15:00-16:00 (60 min available)
- Thu 10:00-10:30 (30 min available)
- Fri 11:00-12:00 (60 min available)

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against these slots and let me know which ones work for all four partners. I recommend we prioritize the longer slots (Mon 09:00, Tue 13:00, Wed 15:00, Fri 11:00) as they give more flexibility.
